definition.en: How the chart organizes self-direction, role orientation and the way a person meets situations. It is a structural domain, not a fixed identity claim.
definition.zh-Hans: 命盘中自我方向、角色取向与面对情境方式的结构领域；它不是固定人格或命运断言。

definition.en: Peer, sibling and lateral-support relationships, including cooperation, comparison and shared resources.
definition.zh-Hans: 同辈、手足与横向支持关系，包括合作、比较与共享资源。

definition.en: Close partnership, reciprocity, commitment patterns and one-to-one relational structure. It does not predict relationship outcomes.
definition.zh-Hans: 亲密伴侣、互惠、承诺与一对一关系结构；不预测关系结果。

definition.en: Generativity, care, offspring-related roles and projects or outputs that extend beyond the self.
definition.zh-Hans: 生成、照护、子女相关角色，以及由自身延伸出去的项目与产出。

definition.en: Material resources, exchange, earning/using patterns and stewardship of what can be allocated. It is not financial advice or a wealth forecast.
definition.zh-Hans: 物质资源、交换、取得与使用资源的模式，以及可分配资源的管理；不是理财建议或财富预测。

definition.en: The body, maintenance load, routines and recovery context as a symbolic domain. It does not diagnose illness or establish medical facts.
definition.zh-Hans: 身体、维持负荷、日常节律与恢复情境的象征领域；不诊断疾病，也不建立医疗事实。

label.zh-Hans: 迁移宫｜外部环境与移动

definition.en: Movement, external environments, relocation, exposure to unfamiliar contexts and how the chart engages the world beyond the familiar base.
definition.zh-Hans: 移动、外部环境、迁移、陌生情境，以及命盘如何接触熟悉基础之外的世界。

definition.en: Friends, colleagues, collaborators, communities and reciprocal network participation.
definition.zh-Hans: 朋友、同事、协作者、社群与互惠网络参与。

label.zh-Hans: 官禄宫｜工作与公共角色

definition.en: Work, vocation, responsibility, contribution and public-role structure. It does not guarantee status or career outcomes.
definition.zh-Hans: 工作、职业、责任、贡献与公共角色结构；不保证职位或事业结果。

definition.en: Home base, property/holdings, living environment and the material foundation that supports continuity.
definition.zh-Hans: 居所、资产持有、生活环境与支持持续性的物质基础。

label.zh-Hans: 福德宫｜内在资源与反思

definition.en: Inner resources, reflective life, rest, satisfaction and the subjective capacity to metabolize experience.
definition.zh-Hans: 内在资源、反思生活、休息、满足感，以及消化经验的主观容量。

label.zh-Hans: 父母宫｜家系与权威支持

definition.en: Parents, lineage, elders, institutions and inherited or formal support relationships.
definition.zh-Hans: 父母、家系、长辈、制度，以及继承性或正式支持关系。

definition.en: Central coordination, integration, stewardship and role-centered organization.
definition.zh-Hans: 中心协调、整合、统筹与以角色为中心的组织能力。

definition.en: Analysis, planning, pattern detection, adjustment and responsive problem-solving.
definition.zh-Hans: 分析、规划、模式辨识、调整与回应式解决问题。

label.zh-Hans: 太阳｜可见性与外向贡献

definition.en: Visibility, outward expression, illumination, contribution and active engagement with others.
definition.zh-Hans: 可见性、向外表达、照亮、贡献与主动参与他人。

definition.en: Execution, resource discipline, measurable action, prioritization and material organization.
definition.zh-Hans: 执行、资源纪律、可衡量行动、优先次序与物质组织。

label.zh-Hans: 天同｜和缓与适应性接纳

definition.en: Ease, receptivity, comfort-seeking, social softness and adaptation through reduced friction.
definition.zh-Hans: 和缓、接纳、舒适取向、社交柔性，以及通过降低摩擦进行适应。

definition.en: Boundaries, standards, attraction/aversion, ethical tension and complex evaluation of what is acceptable.
definition.zh-Hans: 边界、标准、趋近与排斥、伦理张力，以及对可接受范围的复杂评估。

definition.en: Stewardship, storage, continuity, resource holding and stabilizing what has already been established.
definition.zh-Hans: 统筹承载、储存、连续性、资源持有，以及稳定已经建立的结构。

definition.en: Inward reflection, receptivity, reserve, cultivation and attention to subtle or private conditions.
definition.zh-Hans: 内向反思、接纳、储备、培育，以及对细微或私人情境的关注。

definition.en: Appetite, exploration, social exchange, experimentation and attraction toward varied experience.
definition.zh-Hans: 欲求、探索、社交交换、实验，以及被多样经验吸引的倾向。

definition.en: Questioning, debate, language, clarification, ambiguity and the need to examine contested information.
definition.zh-Hans: 质疑、辩论、语言、澄清、模糊性，以及检视争议信息的需求。

definition.en: Mediation, support, procedural order, role coordination and maintaining workable relational arrangements.
definition.zh-Hans: 协调、支持、程序秩序、角色配合，以及维持可运作的关系安排。

definition.en: Protection, principles, oversight, repair and maintaining standards across time.
definition.zh-Hans: 保护、原则、监督、修复，以及跨时间维持标准。

label.zh-Hans: 七杀｜决断压力与切入行动

definition.en: Decisive pressure, concentrated action, risk-bearing and the capacity to cut through delay or ambiguity.
definition.zh-Hans: 决断压力、集中行动、承担风险，以及切开拖延或模糊的能力。

definition.en: Disruption, dismantling, restructuring, renewal and the willingness to replace an exhausted configuration.
definition.zh-Hans: 破旧、拆解、重组、更新，以及替换失效结构的倾向。

definition.en: Practical assistance, coordination and support that helps a structure operate more smoothly.
definition.zh-Hans: 实际协助、协调与让结构更顺畅运作的支持。

definition.en: Relational support, cooperation and complementary help supplied through people or networks.
definition.zh-Hans: 由人际或网络提供的关系支持、合作与互补帮助。

label.zh-Hans: 文昌｜结构化表达与学习

definition.en: Structured expression, learning, documentation, ordering information and making ideas legible.
definition.zh-Hans: 结构化表达、学习、记录、整理信息与让想法更清楚可读。

label.zh-Hans: 文曲｜细腻表达与文化感受

definition.en: Nuanced expression, aesthetic/cultural sensitivity, symbolic communication and modulation of tone.
definition.zh-Hans: 细腻表达、审美与文化感受、象征沟通与语气调节。

definition.en: Facilitation through formal channels, timely support, access or recognition from established structures.
definition.zh-Hans: 来自正式渠道、既有结构的及时支持、通达或认可。

definition.en: Facilitation through interpersonal responsiveness, soft support and useful relational openings.
definition.zh-Hans: 通过人际回应、柔性支持与有用关系入口形成的助力。

definition.en: Increases attraction, access, resource flow or ease around the transformed star. It does not guarantee gain.
definition.zh-Hans: 提高与该星曜相关的趋近、通达、资源流动或顺畅度；不保证获得。

definition.en: Intensifies activation, responsibility, control, pressure to act or capacity to take charge around the transformed star.
definition.zh-Hans: 增强该星曜相关的激活、责任、控制、行动压力或承担能力。

definition.en: Emphasizes articulation, legibility, qualification, recognition or the ability to make a pattern understandable.
definition.zh-Hans: 强调表达清晰、可识别、资格化、认可或让模式更容易被理解。

definition.en: Marks friction, entanglement, constraint, overinvestment or a point requiring closer review. It is not a prediction of harm.
definition.zh-Hans: 标记摩擦、纠结、限制、过度投入或需要更仔细检视的位置；不是伤害预测。
